title: 第1202章 劫后第一装第1201章 雷劫怎么老出问题
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: 只看一眼，当然不是因为多看一眼就要爆炸。
之所以看了一眼，就表情复杂，实在是事出有因，而且这“因”
来自他这。
之前凶敖青又一次出现，郑常带着敖青来找他帮忙，他传了敖青一门以独孤氏三宪法身为基础的分身之法，让他将两者分割。
基础是独孤浩然他们家的三宪法身，但更改的内容嘛，却不是寻常法，寻常法他也改不了独孤氏传承十几万年的法门啊。
这人都是习惯用最近用惯的东西，改的时候，李遁一刚刻录完一道万象天晷呢，自然是用万象天晷处得来的手段改的。
用来限制另一个敖青的手段也是来自万象天晷的。
谁曾想，敖青修行了这样的法门，居然会对雷劫产生影响。
是自己失策了，这个世界规则的程序也是够屎山代码的，明明改的是a，结果b报错了。
“bug”
毕竟是他搞出来的，李遁一还是得管管售后。
他当即驱动从玖那里得来的那一部分“劫罚”
，尝试调整敖青的雷劫。
虽然是第一次影响别人渡劫的劫雷，但毕竟只是化神雷劫，要强行修正并不难。
反正也不是要修正这个bug，只是强行让程序运行下去而已。
反正这“bug”
也不会出第二次了，给敖青的法门，这个世界不会有第二个人练了，练了也练不成。
毕竟去哪找第二个，本源复杂、“人格分裂”
需要分离人格的龙族呢？
“这样就好了，呼~差点坑人了。”
李遁一松了口气。
虽说只要他不说，谁也不知道原因。
渡劫失败了，就算是郑常也只会觉得是敖青运气不好，怀疑也怀疑不到自己头上，但李遁一还是有那么一点点道德包袱的。
不小心把老乡宠物玩死了，实在不是很厚道。
反正是顺手救的，还是救一下吧。
就是这强行影响雷劫，作为“劫罚”
的主人，劫仙应该能感觉到。
敖青那小子，说不定会被劫仙留意呢。
至于是仙人抚我顶，结发受长生呢，还是仙人抚我顶，寸劲开天灵就不好说了。
这售后看来还得接着维护。
“雷劫的间隔好像又恢复正常回来了。”
郑常在脑海里对系统道。
【是啊，好奇怪哦。
我回头得发给分析部看看。
“真是给你捡着了，跟我混，什么奇怪的数据你都能捞到。”
【还好说，你……算了，确实是我捡着了。
系统本想吐槽，但郑常说的也没错。
跟着郑常混，正经奖励拿得少，但各种奇奇怪怪的数据是真的不少，别的不说，世界意志交流数据、道果碎片这种东西都整到了，就问还有谁吧？
以前系统是绩效垫底实习生，现在成狗屎运传奇实习生了。
虽然狗屎运什么的听起来不好听，可运气也是实力的一部分嘛。
按正常节奏来的雷劫，对敖青来说威胁不大，经过九波二十七道雷劫的洗礼，敖青成功蜕变，突破至化神。
残留的劫云也开始化作甘霖，落到地面上，修复着被雷劫损坏的一切。
content_en:
Just take a look, of course not because you will explode if you take another look.
The reason why I glanced at it and had a complicated expression is that it actually happened for a reason, and this "cause"
From him.
The fierce Ao Qing appeared again before, and Zheng Chang brought Ao Qing to him for help. He taught Ao Qing a clone method based on the three constitutions of the Dugu family, and asked him to divide the two.
The foundation is the Three Constitutions of Dugu Haoran and his family, but the content of the changes is not ordinary law. Ordinary laws cannot change the Dugu family's dharma that has been passed down for hundreds of thousands of years.
This person is accustomed to using the things he has been using recently. When he made the modification, Li Dunyi had just finished burning a Vientiane Celestial Dial, so he naturally modified it using the methods he got from the Vientiane Celestial Dial.
The means used to restrict the other Ao Qing also came from the Vientiane Celestial Dial.
Who would have thought that Ao Qing's practice of such a method would actually have an impact on the Thunder Tribulation.
I made a mistake. The program of this world's rules is also a mess of code. I obviously changed a, but b reported an error.
"bug"
After all, he was the one who did it, so Li Dunyi still had to take care of the after-sales service.
He immediately activated the part of "Robbery Punishment" he got from Jiu
, try to adjust Ao Qing's Thunder Tribulation.
Although it was the first time that the tribulation thunder affected others to overcome the tribulation, after all, it was only the tribulation of divine transformation, so it was not difficult to forcefully correct it.
Anyway, it's not to fix this bug, it's just to force the program to run.
Anyway, this "bug"
There won't be a second time. No one in this world will practice the method given to Ao Qing, and even if he practices it, he won't be able to practice it.
After all, where can I find the second one? The origin is complex and "split personality"
What about the dragons who need separate personalities?
"That's good. Huh~ I almost tricked someone."
Li Dun breathed a sigh of relief.
Although as long as he doesn't say it, no one will know the reason.
If he failed to overcome the tribulation, even Zheng Chang would only think that Ao Qing was unlucky and would not suspect him. However, Li Dunyi still had a little bit of moral baggage.
It's really not very kind to accidentally kill a fellow villager's pet.
Anyway, it was easy to save, so let’s save it.
It is this forceful influence on Thunder Tribulation as a "tribulation punishment"
The Master, Tribulation Immortal should be able to feel it.
That kid Ao Qing might be noticed by the Tribulation Immortal.
It’s hard to say whether it’s the immortal who caressed my crown, which will bind my hair and receive immortality, or whether it’s the immortal who caressed my crown, which will activate the heavenly spirit.
It seems that this after-sales service will require continued maintenance.
…
"The intervals between thunder tribulations seem to have returned to normal."
Zheng Chang said to the system in his mind.
[Yes, it’s so strange.
I'll have to send it to the analysis department later.
"I really picked it up for you. If you mess with me, you can get any weird data."
[Fortunately, you... forget it, I did pick it up.
The system wanted to complain, but what Zheng Chang said was right.
When I follow Zheng Chang, I get few serious rewards, but there are really a lot of weird data. Not to mention other things, I have collected things like world will exchange data and Dao fruit fragments. Just ask who else is there?
In the past, the system used to be an intern with the lowest performance, but now he is a legendary intern with bad luck.
Although bullshit luck sounds bad, luck is also a part of strength.
Thunder tribulations coming at a normal pace were not a big threat to Ao Qing. After being baptized by nine waves of twenty-seven thunder tribulations, Ao Qing successfully transformed and broke through to become a god.
The remaining tribulation clouds also began to turn into rain, falling to the ground, repairing everything damaged by the thunder tribulation.
